title: From Pilot to Practice: How BBVA Is Scaling AI Across the Organization
summary_lines: BBVA is reimagining how employees work with ChatGPT Enterprise, embedding AI into everyday operations. The bank has saved hours per week per employee, created 20,000+ Custom GPTs, and achieved up to 80% efficiency gains.
